Title: Relates to zoning modifications and permitting for building projects
Summary: Requires municipalities to grant zoning modifications within ten days of receipt of request for a modification under certain circumstances; provides that a municipality may authorize the developer of a building project to hire an approved third-party inspector for such building project; relates to permits required for certain building projects and exemption from county review for small residential projects; makes related provisions.
LawCode: Add §§98-c, 98-d, 98-e & 98-f, amd §§239-f, 239-m, 239-n & 125, Gen Muni L; amd §24-0301, En Con L; amd §52, Hway L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the general municipal law, the environmental conservation law and the highway law, in relation to zoning modifications and permitting for certain building projects
